chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'dabadi narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah. He said: Abu Abdillah al-Jamurani narrated to us, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Sayf ibn Umayra, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said:
Sitting with the people of religion is the honour of this world and the Hereafter.

key_terms.أهل الدين: People of religion — those devoted to religious learning and practice
key_terms.شرف: Honour, nobility, distinction — both social and spiritual
key_terms.مجالسة: Sitting with, keeping company, associating with — implies deliberate seeking of companionship

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about sitting with religious people?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) taught that keeping company with people of religion brings honour in both this world and the Hereafter. This hadith, delivered to his close companions and transmitted through the Ahl al-Bayt chain, emphasizes the importance of choosing righteous company. In early Islamic society, 'people of religion' (ahl al-din) referred to those devoted to learning, worship, and ethical conduct.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He siad: Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa`d Abadi narrated to us from Ahmad b. Abi `Abdullah. He said: Abu `Abdillah al-Hamurani narrated to us from al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Abi Hamza from Sayf b. Umayra from Mansur b. Hazim from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
Sitting with the people of religion is the honour of this world and the Hereafter.
